en.t: Komako let out a frantic cry,

units.source_text: 岛村企图靠近她，不料被一群汉子连推带搡地撞到一边去。

en.t: Shimamura tried to get close to her, but a group of men shoved and jostled him aside.

units.source_text: 这些汉子是想从驹子手里接过叶子抱走。

en.t: The men were trying to take Yoko from Komako's arms and carry her away.

units.source_text: 待岛村站稳了脚跟，抬头望去，银河好像哗啦一声，向他的心坎上倾泻了下来。

en.t: When Shimamura regained his footing and looked up, the Milky Way seemed to pour down with a rushing sound straight into his heart.
